origin.details: Reads match, start, or end from each first-match record.
origin.value: The match selector on the first column returns Ben and Millard.
origin.example:
pos <- re_exec(c("  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis", "\tMillard Fillmore"), "(?<first>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+) (?<last>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+)")
pos$first$match

translation.description: Reads match, start, or end from each first-match record.
translation.details: Reads match, start, or end from each first-match record.
translation.value: dollar_rematch_records on the first column returns Ben and Millard.
translation.example:
from rematch2 import dollar_rematch_records, re_exec
pos = re_exec(["  Ben Franklin and Jefferson Davis", "\tMillard Fillmore"], "(?<first>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+) (?<last>[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]+)")
print(dollar_rematch_records(pos["first"], "match"))
